evidence_tiers.dac_adjudicated: 39 DAC 2026 records with official presentation descriptions and evidence-cited technical fields
evidence_tiers.isca_primary: 5 ISCA 2026 author-preprint-backed adjudications; 5 additional secondary-index excerpts remain pending primary verification
evidence_tiers.iccad_primary: 5 ICCAD 2025 fallback records with author-preprint or author-PDF evidence; the remaining fallback inventory is metadata-only
evidence_tiers.iccad_scope: ICCAD 2026 official CFP scope signals, separate from the 2025 fallback paper evidence

rows.isca: CODO provides primary-preprint evidence for automated FPGA dataflow compilation; the program also contains architecture/compiler papers
rows.dac: Adjudicated records cover LLM-guided HLS DSE, LLM assertion retrieval, LLM technology-mapping evolution, and learned thermal/physical optimization
rows.iccad: VERIRL and HLSDebugger provide 2025 fallback evidence for RL/LLM-assisted Verilog and HLS debugging; the 2026 CFP separately scopes AI/hardware
rows.limits: The counts are selected adjudications, not prevalence estimates; model quality, cost, and reproducibility vary by task.

rows.isca: Primary-preprint evidence covers MoE movement forecasting, quantized LUT GEMM, disaggregated training, and thermal coordination
rows.dac: Official-description adjudications cover eDRAM KV buffering, mobile NPU-PIM speculative decoding, and rewrite-free sparse-attention PIM
rows.iccad: Tasa provides 2025 fallback evidence for thermal-aware 3D-stacked LLM inference; 2026 CFP includes AI/hardware and physical AI
rows.limits: The shared LLM label spans workload analysis, memory, packaging, and security; it is not one homogeneous technical trend.

rows.isca: Patterns Behind Chaos, DisDP, OASIS, and the indexed ConServe excerpt treat expert traffic, collectives, quantization, and KV locality as first-class constraints
rows.dac: MBA, AHASD, REFLEX, CXL near-memory ANN, and CIM records provide evidence for memory placement and movement-aware execution
rows.iccad: Tasa and the ICCAD 2026 scope connect memory bandwidth to 3D integration and thermal constraints
rows.limits: No normalized cross-conference metric exists; movement benefits depend on workload, topology, memory technology, and baseline.

rows.isca: ISCA evidence is currently sparse for classic EDA flows, though CODO links compilation to accelerator generation
rows.dac: DCTS, timing analysis, sequential characterization, DRC, thermal prediction, LegoTherm, power-grid modeling, and package-plane synthesis are adjudicated
rows.iccad: RSizing adds robust analog sizing evidence; the 2026 CFP explicitly covers synthesis, placement/routing/CTS, timing, power, signal integrity, DFM, yield, reliability, and analog/RF/EM
rows.limits: ICCAD scope is not paper prevalence, and DAC records are a selected adjudication batch rather than the full corpus.

rows.direction: Reliability and security as design constraints
rows.isca: Lit Silicon provides primary-preprint evidence for thermal stragglers; indexed BusyBarn evidence includes fault-tolerant wafer-scale inference
rows.dac: Adjudications cover NPU reliability, EM/IR integrity, remote ML-KEM leakage, and adversarial MoE offloading
rows.iccad: Energon, the Fellowship of the Leak metadata signal, and the 2026 CFP cover side channels, security, reliability, DFM/yield, and advanced integration
rows.limits: Threat, thermal, and fault models differ; security, reliability, and thermal management remain separate analytic subtrees.

rows.isca: Primary and program evidence includes wafer-scale systems, PIM, quantum compilation, and spatial accelerators
rows.dac: Adjudicated records include chiplet thermal modeling, package power-plane synthesis, CIM, exact quantum synthesis, and emerging memory
rows.iccad: Tasa and the 2026 CFP explicitly cover post-CMOS, non-von Neumann, quantum, neuromorphic, 3D ICs, chiplets, packaging, and physical AI
rows.limits: The evidence supports active research scope and technical cases, not maturity, adoption, or commercial direction.

prohibited_inference: rising or declining direction without comparable historical snapshots
